title: Action Recipe
description: Output must be exactly one of two states: SUCCESS (an ordered recipe of steps) or ERROR (why no recipe could be produced).

offset.description: Distance in meters to stand off along Z.

objectName.description: Must exactly match one of the names in Available Objects.

vectorName.description: Must exactly match one of the known relative movement names.

orientationName.description: Must exactly match one of the known orientation preset names in Available Orientations.

speedScale.description: Velocity/acceleration scaling factor for this move. Omit, or use 0.0, to fall back to the arm's configured default speed.

angleRadians.description: Angle in radians, applied as an orientation delta from the arm's current pose.

direction.description: Direction relative to the object's own original bearing from the arm's base, not the arm's own facing. 'forward' continues further out along that same bearing; 'backward' reverses it; 'left'/'right' rotate it +90/-90 degrees.

distance.description: Distance in meters to move along the chosen 'direction'. Default varies by action - see the specific action's own description of this field.

graspStyle.description: 'side' computes and verifies a flat, side-on grasp from the object's own shape/pose (BOX shapes only currently) - each candidate is checked reachable/collision-free before use, not assumed from a fixed preset. Omit for the default: unconstrained orientation at the object's exact center, whatever the planner picks.

graspOffset.description: Manual x/y/z shift in meters off the object's registered center for the approach point. Only meaningful paired with an explicit manual 'orientation' - an orientation that's valid at one point in space isn't necessarily valid at a different point (e.g. the object's exact center).

liftHeight.description: Meters to lift/raise the held object straight up before the rest of the motion.

oneOf.description: SUCCESS: all referenced objects exist and the routine can be safely constructed.

recipe_name.description: Short, descriptive title of the routine

oneOf.description: Move the arm to its safe starting pose. Takes no parameters.
Move the arm to a named object's coordinates.

orientation.description: Optional absolute end-effector orientation to hold at the target. Omit to let the planner pick any orientation.

oneOf.description: Move the arm relative to its current position by a named displacement vector.

orientation.description: Optional orientation delta applied on top of the arm's current orientation. Omit to keep the current orientation unchanged.

oneOf.description: Open or close the gripper to an exact position.
Composite: open the gripper, move to the target, close the gripper, and mark it grasped.

grasp_style.description: Set to 'side' for a computed, verified flat side-on grasp - required before 'pour'/'thrust', which both expect the object to start out level and pointing outward. Omit for the default unconstrained grasp (fine for a plain pickup/dropoff/throw with no pour or thrust afterward).

orientation.description: Manual orientation override, ignored if 'grasp_style' is given. Forcing an orientation can make an otherwise-reachable approach unreachable for the planner, so omit unless specifically needed - and pair it with a matching 'grasp_offset', since an orientation that's valid at one point isn't necessarily valid at the object's exact center.

grasp_offset.description: Manual x/y/z shift off the object's center, ignored if 'grasp_style' is given. Only meaningful paired with an explicit manual 'orientation'.

open_position.description: Gripper position to open to before approaching. Defaults to 0.0 (open) if omitted.

close_position.description: Gripper position to close to once at the target. Defaults to 0.8 if omitted.

oneOf.description: Composite: move to the destination, release the gripper, and mark the held object placed.

target.description: The object currently held. Required: its own height is used to compute a collision-safe release position above the destination, and its stored pose is updated to the destination once released.

place_offset.description: Height added above the destination before releasing. Defaults to 0.1 if omitted.

open_position.description: Gripper position to release to. Defaults to 0.0 (open) if omitted.

oneOf.description: Carry the currently held object above a destination, tilt to pour, hold briefly, then return level.

target.description: The object currently held. Required, and must be the object the preceding 'pickup' grasped (ideally with grasp_style: 'side', so it starts out level) - pour verifies it's actually the held object and fails rather than guessing if not.

destination.description: Named destination to carry the object above before tilting. Alternative to 'direction' - give exactly one of the two.

direction.description: Direction to carry the object in, relative to its own original bearing from the arm, before tilting. Alternative to 'destination' - give exactly one of the two. Requires 'distance' to be meaningful.

distance.description: Only used with 'direction'. Defaults to 0.3 if omitted.

lift_height.description: How high to lift the object above its grasp height before carrying it toward the destination. Defaults to 0.14 if omitted.

tilt_angle.description: How far to tilt to pour - a pure wrist-joint rotation, not a Cartesian angle. Defaults to 2.356 (135 degrees) if omitted.

duration.description: Seconds to hold the tilt before returning level. Defaults to 1.5 if omitted.

oneOf.description: Raise the currently held object and thrust it toward a destination - a fast, forceful single-plane motion.

target.description: The object currently held. Required, and must be the object the preceding 'pickup' grasped (ideally with grasp_style: 'side', so it starts out level and pointing outward) - thrust verifies it's actually the held object and fails rather than guessing if not.

destination.description: Named destination to thrust the object toward. Alternative to 'direction' - give exactly one of the two.

direction.description: Direction to thrust the object in, relative to its own original resting bearing from the arm (from before it was picked up). Alternative to 'destination' - give exactly one of the two. Requires 'distance' to be meaningful.

distance.description: Only used with 'direction'. Defaults to 0.4 if omitted - verified as close to the practical reach limit for a clean, collision-free swing (~77 degrees of shoulder motion); going noticeably further (0.5+) risks the motion becoming unreliable.

lift_height.description: How high to raise the object before spinning/extending toward the destination. Defaults to 0.14 if omitted.

speed.description: Defaults to 1.0 (full speed) if omitted - thrust is meant to be fast and forceful, unlike pour/push's more careful pace.

oneOf.description: Slide an object to a destination by sustained contact, without ever grasping or lifting it - a single-plane motion facing the object directly.

target.description: The object to push. Unlike pickup/pour/thrust, this object is never grasped - push faces it directly and slides it along the surface by contact.

destination.description: Named destination to push the object to. Alternative to 'direction' - give exactly one of the two.

direction.description: Direction to push the object by, relative to its own original bearing from the arm. Alternative to 'destination' - give exactly one of the two. Requires 'distance' to be meaningful. Push only ever extends an object further from the arm's own base - it's not designed to drag one back in, so avoid 'backward' unless truly needed.

distance.description: Only used with 'direction'. Defaults to 0.2 if omitted.

close_position.description: How far the gripper closes to act as a flat pushing surface. Defaults to 0.75 if omitted.

oneOf.description: Wind up and fling the currently held object toward a destination in one continuous swing, releasing the instant the arm reaches its captured release point mid-swing - not after a fixed delay or once the arm has stopped.

target.description: The object currently held. Required, and must be the object the preceding 'pickup' grasped - throw verifies it's actually the held object and fails rather than guessing if not.

destination.description: Named destination to throw the object toward. Alternative to 'direction' - give exactly one of the two.

direction.description: Direction to throw the object in, relative to its own original bearing from the arm. Alternative to 'destination' - give exactly one of the two. Requires 'distance' to be meaningful.

distance.description: Only used with 'direction', to compute which way to face before swinging - the wind-up/fling shape itself is fixed, not scaled by this value. Defaults to 0.3 if omitted.

open_position.description: Gripper position to release to. Defaults to 0.0 (open) if omitted.

speed.description: Velocity/acceleration scale for the rotate/wind-up moves only - the fling itself always runs at full speed regardless of this value. Omit for the arm's configured default.

oneOf.description: ERROR: an object is missing, ambiguous, or the command violates workspace constraints.

message.description: Detailed natural language explanation of why the command failed execution.
